description: Source code for IPC handler functions related to automation service, including statistics retrieval, automation creation/deletion/modification, status checks, and token validation.

methods.name: handle_automationService_GET_RUNTIME_STATS_request
methods.description: Retrieves current runtime statistics of the automation service, including event, IPC, and memory stats.

methods.name: handle_automationService_GET_SERVICE_STATUS_request
methods.description: Returns the current status of the automation service (not implemented).

methods.name: handle_automationService_CONFIG_RESTORED_request
methods.description: Handles configuration restore event, allowing the service to import files from a restore directory.

methods.name: handle_CREATE_AUTOMATION_request
methods.description: Creates a new automation based on provided specifications and broadcasts creation event.

methods.name: handle_DELETE_AUTOMATION_request
methods.description: Deletes an existing automation and broadcasts deletion event.

methods.name: handle_SET_AUTOMATION_request
methods.description: Updates an automation's enabled state and specification, including transcoding if needed, then broadcasts modification event.

methods.name: handle_GET_AUTOMATIONS_request
methods.description: Retrieves list of all automations with their details.

methods.name: handle_SET_AUTOMATION_ENABLED_request
methods.description: Enables or disables an automation and broadcasts modification event.

methods.name: handle_IS_VALID_TOKEN_request
methods.description: Validates if a given token (rule ID) exists among automations.
